_comment: Holiday event windows (roadmap P1). Config-driven: add/edit events here, no code changes. 'missions' are case-insensitive folder-name prefixes from the server download dir (DayZ-Central-Economy packs). 'windows' are inclusive calendar-day ranges in the viewer's local timezone: [[start, end], ...]. While a window is live, that mission's marker set is on by default on map.html; outside a window it is off by default (staff can still toggle it).
